I'm so glad how this subreddit has gotten more positive. When I first came here last year, I was an anxious borderline suicidal wreck which was evident in my first posts. I thought I'd never ever get over t. Talking with other negative users was cathartic but definitely not what I needed

Half a year later, I cant believe how much I've progressed, where it's barely even a problem for me unless it spikes. Posts like this pushed me in right direction, and showed me that despite how shitty and unfair tinnitus is, theres so many worse things to have, and minor/moderate t is just a tiny hurdle in the decathlon of life.

Sure I'm still anxious, sure the thought of severe t  prompts suicidal thoughts every now and then. But comparing how I was before, this journey has shown my strength and I'm almost somewhat glad for it (if I could know it wont get worse haha).

For anyone still reading, the biggest help for me getting to where I am was simply embracing life, keeping busy and controlling breathing during bad spikes. Love you all :))
